concepts.name: Script
concepts.description: A knowledge representation for capturing causally coherent set of events with six main components: entry conditions, results, props, roles, tracks, and scenes

properties.name: entry_conditions
properties.type: object

properties.name: results
properties.type: object

properties.name: props
properties.type: list

properties.name: roles
properties.type: list

properties.name: track
properties.type: list

properties.name: scenes
properties.type: list

concepts.name: Entry Conditions
concepts.description: The conditions necessary to execute a script, representing prerequisites that must be satisfied before the script can be invoked

properties.name: agent_state
properties.type: object - required states of participating agents (e.g., hungry, has_money)

properties.name: environmental_state
properties.type: object - required environmental conditions

properties.name: resource_availability
properties.type: list - required objects or resources that must be present

properties.name: satisfaction_requirement
properties.type: boolean - all conditions must be true for script activation

concepts.name: Result
concepts.description: The conditions that will become true after the script has occurred and taken place, representing the expected outcomes

properties.name: agent_state_changes
properties.type: object - how agent states are modified (e.g., no_longer_hungry, less_money)

properties.name: environmental_changes
properties.type: object - modifications to the environment

properties.name: resource_transfers
properties.type: list - movement or consumption of objects

properties.name: satisfaction_states
properties.type: object - final satisfaction or completion states

concepts.name: Props
concepts.description: Objects involved in the execution of the script

properties.name: object_type
properties.type: string - category of object

properties.name: function
properties.type: string - purpose or use of the object

properties.name: location
properties.type: string - where the object is typically found

concepts.name: Roles
concepts.description: Agents involved in the execution of the script

properties.name: agent_type
properties.type: string - category of agent (customer, waiter, cook, etc.)

properties.name: responsibilities
properties.type: list - expected behaviors and duties

properties.name: capabilities
properties.type: list - abilities and skills of the role

concepts.name: Track
concepts.description: Variations or subclasses of a particular script representing different specializations

properties.name: script_type
properties.type: string - type of script this track belongs to

properties.name: specific_conditions
properties.type: object - conditions specific to this track variation

properties.name: specialized_events
properties.type: list - events unique to this track

concepts.name: Scenes
concepts.description: The sequence of events that occur during script execution

properties.name: event_sequence
properties.type: ordered_list - temporal ordering of events within the scene

properties.name: participants
properties.type: list - agents involved in the scene

properties.name: actions
properties.type: list - actions performed in the scene

properties.name: preconditions
properties.type: object - conditions required before scene execution

properties.name: postconditions
properties.type: object - conditions that result from scene execution

concepts.name: Event
concepts.description: Observable actions or state changes in the world

properties.name: actor
properties.type: string - agent performing the action

properties.name: action
properties.type: string - action being performed

properties.name: object
properties.type: string - object being acted upon

properties.name: preconditions
properties.type: object - conditions required before event

properties.name: postconditions
properties.type: object - conditions resulting from event

concepts.name: Story Understanding
concepts.description: The application of scripts to comprehend narratives by filling in gaps and making coherent connections between events

properties.name: narrative_comprehension
properties.type: process - understanding story structure and meaning

properties.name: gap_filling
properties.type: process - inferring missing information using script knowledge

properties.name: causal_reasoning
properties.type: process - connecting events through cause-effect relationships

concepts.name: Expectation Generation
concepts.description: The cognitive process by which scripts help generate predictions about what will happen in familiar situations

properties.prediction_mechanism: process - how scripts generate expectations about future events
properties.default_assumptions: list - typical expectations derived from script knowledge
properties.violation_detection: process - recognition when expectations are not met
properties.emotional_responses: list - reactions when expectations are violated

concepts.name: Script-based Reasoning
concepts.description: The process of using script knowledge to understand situations and make inferences

properties.situation_classification: process - determining which script applies to a situation
properties.script_instantiation: process - filling in specific values for script variables
properties.inference_generation: process - deriving conclusions from script knowledge

Instances.name: Restaurant Script
Instances.description: A specific instance of a script representing the stereotypical sequence of events when dining at a restaurant

Relations.name: has_track
Relations.description: A script has multiple tracks representing variations

Relations.name: precedes
Relations.description: One event precedes another in a sequence

Relations.name: causes
Relations.description: One event causally leads to another

Relations.name: instantiates
Relations.description: A specific story instantiates a general script
